notes.title: Version 0.6.9
notes.notes:
Changelog for version 0.6.9:
[list]
[*]Fixed a regression that prevented fixed components from loading correctly, affecting levels 8 and 32.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.6.8
notes.notes:
Changelog for version 0.6.8:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed passing tests without using all outputs on levels with multiple outputs.
[*]Fixed the 'Random Passthrough' component not using a new seed, which caused it to produce the same result on levels with a fixed seed, like Level 53.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.6.7
notes.notes:
Changelog for version 0.6.7:
[list]
[*] Fixed a regression where components could not be properly selected when the mouse was dragged very quickly during selection (they appeared selected but behaved as separate objects).
[*] Fixed a regression that caused the sound for a clicked button to play when picking a component from the board.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.6.6
notes.notes:
Changelog for version  0.6.6:

[list]
[*] Fixed a typo in the tooltip for the Demux component.
[*] Fixed an issue with "prev" lines in histograms being drawn when the result falls outside the interval.
[*] Added a check to prevent blueprints containing source or I/O components.
[*] Added new test cases and updated existing ones for levels 30 and 40 to prevent solutions that only work for specific inputs.
[*] Updated the option for automatically creating a new solution for levels without solutions (accessible via the Next Level and Previous Level buttons in the Histograms menu) to also apply when loading a level from the "Levels" menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.6.5
notes.notes:
Changelog for version 0.6.5:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented components from rotating using keyboard controls.
[*] Fixed a Windows-specific issue preventing renaming solutions when the new name differed only in letter casing.
[*] Added two labels in the controls menu: "Primary Controls" and "Alternative Controls."
[*] Added an option to change the default name of new solutions.
[*] Added an option in the histograms dialog to directly load a solution using the Next Level and Previous Level buttons, if only one solution exists.
[*] Added an option in the histograms dialog to automatically create a new solution for levels without one when using the Next Level and Previous Level buttons.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.6.4 and a Web Demo
notes.notes:
Changelog for version 0.6.4:
[list]
[*] Web demo available at [url=https://updevgames.com/octopticom3d_web/]https://updevgames.com/octopticom3d_web/[/url] and [url=https://updevgames.itch.io/octopticom-3d/]https://updevgames.itch.io/octopticom-3d/[/url]
[*] Added sound effects for the blueprints buttons.
[*] Added support for importing saves from the web demo.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.6.3
notes.notes:
Changelog for version 0.6.3:
[list]
[*]Added one more deterministic test case for Level 54 (Multiplication).
[*]Fixed an issue where a key for deleting selected components was not working.
[*]Fixed a bug in the XOR gate component showing nonexistent loops.
[*]Fixed an issue where a solution was saved under its old name instead of the new name after being renamed.
[*]Fixed histograms not displaying when bins are very small.
[*]Components can now be selected and deselected during a simulation.
[*]Selected components now update dynamically while panning and zooming while selecting.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.6.2 and a Demo
notes.notes:
Changelog for version 0.6.2:
[list]
[*]Fixed Switch 2 leaking in certain cases.
[*]Fixed random passthrough causing nonexistent loops.
[*]Added a sound effect for clicked buttons, which can be disabled in the settings.
[*]Corrected Level 54 (Multiplication) to use non-streaming instead of streaming I/O.
[*]Added a simple tutorial in Level 1.
[/list]
A demo with the first 18 levels is now also available.

notes.title: Version 0.6.1
notes.notes:
Changelog for version 0.6.1:
[list]
[*] Added a new test case for level 49 (Sort), made some cells' colors deterministic to prevent non-deterministic solutions, and reset leaderboards and histograms.
[*] Added tick marks in histogram graphs.
[*] Adjusted tick marks and numbers for histograms where bins equal the max value (aligned with bin centers).
[*] Fixed positioning of 'best' and 'latest' lines in histograms.
[*] Added 'prev' stats for the histograms (previous run data).
[*] Rearranged metrics in solutions and histograms for consistency.
[*] Simulation restarts from test 1 after stopping on a different test.
[*] Added version checking and last changes panel.
[*] Added Discord and Reddit links.
[*] Switch type 1 can now detect when it is in an infinite loop.
[/list]
